body:
## Outcome

Establish an evidence-backed catalog of the designs and behaviors HIG must carry across repositories.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Audit hyperliquid, chart, font, sfx, and haptic apps/docs plus bloxwap.app, bloxwap.pro, bloxwap.com, and the React Native app.
- Inventory packages/tokens, packages/ui, packages/ui-native, packages/plain-ui, and app/pro-owned primitives. Record source repo, commit, path, screenshots, live consumers, and intended platform differences.
- Classify each existing component as adopt, consolidate, redesign, or retire; measure duplicate files, exported variants, dependencies, and bundle baselines.
- Create a minimum complete v1 catalog from actual usage. Include platform applicability, states, accessibility expectations, docs coverage, and migration owner for each entry; add newly discovered work to this roadmap.
- Inventory every active Bloxwap repository and its UI/docs surface, including repositories without runtime UI. Capture baseline tasks/issues to reuse rather than duplicate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every named reference has a traceable design/behavior entry and before screenshots; source-derived and live-site observations are distinguished.
- [ ] All existing web/native primitive forks and plain HTML/CSS consumers have an explicit disposition; legitimate app versus Pro differences are retained as documented density/platform decisions.
- [ ] The v1 catalog has no unassigned component family or missing platform decision, and every active repository appears in an adoption matrix.
- [ ] A baseline report records duplicated files, CSS/font/audio asset bytes, and representative React/Metro bundles for later comparison.

## Prerequisites

Ready to start. This issue establishes the evidence for the remaining roadmap.

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Inventory existing Bloxwap interfaces and define the v1 component catalog
